description: GraphQL fidelity scenarios for the interpretation boundary: live introspection observes the schema the invocation's own request reaches, a pin is dispatched as carried, and a structural absence refuses before any wire traffic. Scenarios for the value boundary arrive with §6 to §9.

scenarios.description: Live introspection carries the invocation's configured protocol fields on the probe, the composed query, and the operation, so the interpreted schema is the one the invocation reaches.

A pinned schema is never repaired by re-introspection: the service's request error against a pin-validated document is the invocation's unsuccessful completion, with no output and exactly one request.
A structural introspection member absent at an element the operation reaches refuses before dispatch with no wire traffic at all.
A partial result crosses the boundary as a successful value and the invocation then completes unsuccessfully: the value stands and is not withdrawn.
The GET lane carries the same protocol fields as the POST lane and encodes the operation in the URL; the operation document is never rewritten.
